name: Tuomo Suntola
summary: Finnish inventor of Atomic Layer Epitaxy (ALE) and former Chief Scientist at Lohja and Microchemistry.

name: Riikka L. Puurunen
summary: Author of this essay and researcher at VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland.

name: Thor Stubb
summary: Professor at Helsinki University of Technology and Suntola's thesis supervisor.

name: Jorma Antson
summary: Colleague of Suntola in humidity sensor and ALE-EL development.

name: Sven Lindfors
summary: Closest co-worker to Suntola in ALE reactor design since 1975 and co-founder of Picosun Oy.

name: Arto Pakkala
summary: Colleague in ALE-EL development who reacted to the successful ZnCl2/H2S process.

name: Helsinki University of Technology
summary: University where Suntola studied and later worked as an assistant teacher.

name: VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland
summary: Research centre where Suntola worked on humidity sensors before moving to Instrumentarium.

name: Instrumentarium Oy
summary: Medical instrumentation company where Suntola invented ALE in 1974.

name: Lohja Oy
summary: Building material company that acquired the ALE-EL project in 1978 and started pilot production.

name: Microchemistry Ltd
summary: Company established by Suntola in 1987 as a subsidiary of Neste to develop ALE-based solar panels and reactors.

name: Neste Oy
summary: National oil company that established Microchemistry and employed Suntola as a Research Fellow.

name: Picosun Oy
summary: Company founded by Lindfors and Poutiainen in 2004, which Suntola joined as scientific adviser.

name: ASM
summary: Dutch company that acquired Microchemistry in 1999.

name: Planar Inc
summary: American competitor that acquired Lohja's EL business in 1990.

name: Beneq Oy
summary: Company that acquired Planar's EL plant in Olarinluoma in 2012.

name: Tampere
summary: City in Finland where Suntola was born.

name: Turku
summary: City in Finland where Suntola went to school.

name: Espoo
summary: City in Finland where Instrumentarium and Lohja facilities were located.

name: Lohja
summary: City in Finland where Lohja plant was located.

name: Atomic Layer Epitaxy
summary: Thin film growth technique invented by Suntola in 1974 based on saturating gas-solid reactions.

name: Humicap sensor
summary: Humidity sensor developed by Suntola and Antson at VTT by 1973.

name: ALE Patent 1974
summary: International patent on ALE filed by Suntola with priority date November 29, 1974.

name: ALE Patent 1979
summary: Second international ALE patent covering inert gas reactors and chloride processes.

name: F-120 reactor
summary: First commercial ALD reactor designed by Suntola and Lindfors at Microchemistry.

name: European SEMI Award 2004
summary: Award honoring Suntola as a pioneer in Atomic Layer Deposition Techniques.

name: The Dynamic Universe
summary: Book by Suntola published in 2011 on a unified picture of physical reality.
